name: transfer-ownership-card
title: Transfer ownership card
description: Hand a workspace to another member: pick the new owner, read what changes, and confirm by typing the workspace name in a dialog that names what you are giving away.
docs: members are the people you would allow as the new owner; a member with disabledReason is listed but cannot be chosen. onTransfer(memberId) may be async: resolve to nothing when it worked, or resolve to (or throw) a message when it failed, and the card keeps the choice and shows it. Leave consequences out for a default list that names the new owner, and confirmDescription out for the default dialog text; say what is true for your product in both. onCancel adds a Cancel button for flows the person can leave.
